column5: 74 cases of the L0 text codecs and number conversion (cx/text): tx_utf8_put, tx_utf8_count, tx_hex_encode, tx_hex_decode, tx_b64_encode, tx_b64_decode (strict: padding, alphabet, length), tx_from_i64, tx_from_u64, tx_to_i64 and tx_to_u64 (bases 2 to 36, overflow refused, a failure leaves the output untouched).
